timing_baseline_relative.test: Timing CV%% Relative to AES-256-GCM Baseline (Architecture Path)
timing_baseline_relative.methodology: Measures PQCProxy.decapsulate() — the actual architecture operation (ML-KEM decapsulation + ML-DSA signing + HKDF derivation), not raw liboqs decap_secret() alone — against AES-256-GCM (also part of this architecture) as a same-run, same-hardware constant-time noise-floor reference, per the approach used in published PQC benchmarking work (e.g. arXiv:2605.17061).
timing_baseline_relative.interpretation: CV%% is reported relative to this environment's own measured noise floor (AES-256-GCM), and measured on the full architecture decapsulation path, not the underlying library in isolation. See TEST 5 (TVLA) for the rigorous leakage assessment on this same path.
